g.title: agentDrilldown
g.text: Inside each agent — the process every stage runs, and who acts at each step
Amber = the Human’s step · indigo = the agent working alone · purple = HAARPi, the conductor.
= the revision cycle: where a gate sends the work when it does not mint, and the path back ·

At each gate HAARPi decomposes the unresolved comments one at a time and builds the chain their needs require; “all resolved” mints the release. rayleigh is one tool split across stages 2 & 4; raconteur climbs three gate cycles.

g.title: l1_b
g.text: Human sets the brief (a short interview):
the question, how many sources, the

g.title: l2_s
g.text: rayleigh init: Human + Claude settle the analytical
framework in a live session (too open-ended to default)

g.title: l3_s
g.text: Human + Claude DESIGN & CHECK the plan (one session):
contracts), FREEZE the test suite (unit tests, module
gates, goldens), then freeze-review it - red-before-

g.title: l4_s
g.text: rayleigh plan: Human + Claude design the executable

g.title: l6_a
g.text: razzle interview: Human gives the facts a tool must
never invent (a script): the format, the venue, date,

g.title: l1_c
g.text: collect: Human adds each real source to Zotero
WITH its PDF - verifying it exists

g.title: l1_r
g.text: (the FIRST draft; later, only a redirect re-plans it)

g.title: l1_h
g.text: HAARPi decomposes the markup ONE COMMENT AT A TIME
into what each asks for (edit / sources / section /
ingest / cite / correct / redirect), then BUILDS the

g.title: l1_rev
g.text: revise -> answers EVERY comment in kind:
a tracked rewrite where prose can carry it, a
requested section drafted and spliced in at the
comment that asked, corrections applied document-wide

g.title: l2_h
g.text: HAARPi evaluates the edited draft, parses the
unresolved comments, and by their SEVERITY
any severity re-opens the design session

g.title: l3_build
g.text: build: a local-LLM doer implements each task against
its frozen unit test; a repair loop climbs an escalation

g.title: l3_test
g.text: test (no LLM): the task's unit test, then the
MODULE GATE; regression keeps the frozen tree green
